recipe.description: The traditional speculaas recipe from the Van der Aar family.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.extraFlour: Extra flour for dusting the speculaas mould.

instructions.title: Method
instructions.step1: Knead the butter, salt, eggs, sugar, flour and speculaas spice mix together until a smooth dough forms. Leave the dough to rest in a cool place for 24 hours. When using a new speculaas mould for the first time, lightly grease it. Preheat the oven to 200°C and then reduce the temperature to 175°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
instructions.step2: Lightly dust the speculaas mould with flour and make sure all of the details are covered. Tap out any excess flour. Take a piece of dough and press it evenly into the mould by hand. Use a knife or cutting wire to remove any excess dough flush with the surface of the mould. Turn the mould over and tap it gently so the shaped dough falls out.
instructions.tip: The flour helps prevent the dough from sticking to the speculaas mould.
